The Takeaway

This model is not aspirational. It's causal.
Shadow Al → Visibility
Grounded Al → Reliability
Managed Al → Reproducibility
Agentic Al → Accountability

Most organizations fail at Al not because models are weak, but because they solve
later constraints first.

They scale what they can't observe.
They automate what they can't reproduce.
They deploy agents they can't own.

The real question isn't "Are we using Al?"
It's "Which constraint is blocking our next move?"
That answer determines what you should build next.

It presents key takeaways on how to approach AI implementation, focusing on addressing fundamental constraints rather than just using AI for the sake of using it.
